sources.title: Omnara agents/configuration
sources.finding: YAML/JSON config selects provider/model/tools, versioned profiles and skills. Product subagents have model overrides, messaging, parent return, depth/instance caps and shared machines. Project memory stores retain current files without history.

sources.title: Omnara agents/overview
sources.finding: Dashboard/CLI/API launch durable agent conversations; activity exposes running, waiting, idle, archived, processes and subagents. Wait requires no background work; stop retains conversation.

sources.title: Omnara agents/failure-handling
sources.finding: Postgres event state survives worker crashes; another worker resumes saved steps without automatic tool rerun. Model calls retry up to eight times; interrupted external tools have unknown outcomes. Approval state persists.

sources.title: Omnara machines/overview
sources.finding: Own laptop/VM or provider sandbox executes commands via outbound daemon. Agent state belongs to control plane. Offline execution host returns retryable errors and need not preserve a live command result.

sources.title: Omnara machines/pools
sources.finding: Managed Ubuntu machines include dev tools; own provider image/snapshot supported. Files/processes survive idle suspension until deletion. Project grants and pool maximum capacity are hard limits.

sources.title: Omnara organization/members
sources.finding: Org owner/admin/member and project admin/developer/operator/viewer have explicit permissions. Operators can launch, send input, resolve interactions and stop shared agents.

sources.title: Omnara organization/model-providers
sources.finding: API keys and custom compatible endpoints including local vLLM; project model grants and token/time limits. Presets OpenAI/Anthropic/OpenRouter are model providers, not CLI harnesses.

sources.title: Omnara tools/permissions
sources.finding: Built-in/custom tools default allow; MCP default ask. Config declares allow/ask/deny per tool; updates required to change permission policy.

sources.title: Omnara tools/mcp
sources.finding: Connect third-party MCP tools including bearer secrets and OAuth.

sources.title: Omnara tools/skills
sources.finding: Versioned SKILL.md packages load on demand and are shared through explicit project grants; latest revision resolves at each model call.

sources.title: Omnara events/sending-input
sources.finding: Queued/steering inputs can be reordered/canceled/promoted; config changes take effect on next model call. Inputs attribute authenticated users or project actors.

sources.title: Omnara events/artifacts
sources.finding: Immutable artifact IDs and digests reference uploaded media; downloadable timeline cards remain after execution-machine removal.

sources.title: Omnara events/webhooks
sources.finding: Event webhooks watch agent/profile/project, optionally sign payloads and retry up to ten minutes; deliveries may duplicate or arrive out of order.

sources.title: Omnara self-hosting/deployment
sources.finding: Full API/worker/maintenance/frontend deployment uses own Postgres, Redis, S3-compatible bucket and memory filesystem; Docker Compose supports local/production.

sources.title: Omnara self-hosting/configuration
sources.finding: OIDC login connectors include Google, Keycloak, Okta, Auth0, Azure and ZITADEL. Self-host configuration defines service/model/machine settings.

sources.title: Omnara introduction
sources.finding: Web interface, CLI, REST API and TypeScript SDK; open-source self-hostable platform under Apache 2.0.

sources.title: Omnara pricing
sources.finding: Full platform $0 with no seat fees. Own models/machines free; managed models provider rates; managed runtime $0.0414/GiB-hour and retention $0.20016/GiB/30 days. No card. SOC2 Type II observation period in progress.

sources.title: Omnarad v0.2.17
sources.finding: 2026-11-04 omnarad v0.2.17 (not a prerelease) adds agent status as GitHub checks on pull requests; macOS daemon binaries require macOS 13 or later.

sources.title: Omnara examples/slack-coding-agent/agent.yaml
sources.finding: Official example agent instruction tells the parent to give each self helper sharing its machine its own checkout via `git worktree add` and to work only there; worktree use is instruction text in this example config.

sources.title: Omnara sandbox providers
sources.locator: docs/machines/providers/overview.mdx lines 8-27 (Compare providers table), commit 89a8ec9 (tag cluster-v0.2.19)
sources.finding: Machine pools can use twelve sandbox providers; the table lists Daytona as containers and Agent37/Modal as gVisor containers, and Blaxel, boxd, CreateOS, E2B, Superserve, Unikraft as microVMs and Arker, Freestyle, Tenki as full VMs. Hosted organizations start with a managed Blaxel microVM pool.

sources.title: Omnara GitHub integration PR tools
sources.locator: docs/integrations/github.mdx lines 142-191 (PR tools: read, discussion_comment, review_comment, reply, start/submit/discard review), commit 89a8ec9 (tag cluster-v0.2.19)
sources.finding: A GitHub-launched agent gets tools scoped to its assigned pull request: read details/diff/files/comments/reviews, post conversation and inline diff comments, reply, and build and submit a COMMENT review (it cannot approve or request changes).

sources.title: Omnara GitHub Git credentials
sources.finding: Agents can get HTTPS Git credentials from the GitHub App integration; they are read-only unless 'Let agents push code' is enabled, in which case agents can push with ordinary git commands, subject to GitHub repository rules.

sources.title: Omnara incoming PR work
sources.locator: docs/integrations/github.mdx lines 240-260 (Configure incoming PR work), commit 89a8ec9 (tag cluster-v0.2.19)
sources.finding: A configured profile can launch an agent when a pull request is opened, when the bot is mentioned, or both; PR comments, reviews and synchronize commits are forwarded to the agent.

sources.title: Omnara integration launches and schedules
sources.locator: docs/integrations/overview.mdx lines 175-259 (Launch from provider events; Start a new thread on a schedule), commit 89a8ec9 (tag cluster-v0.2.19)
sources.finding: Slack/Discord mentions and GitHub PR events launch agents; integration schedules (cron + timezone, also via the cron-triggers API) launch a fresh agent per occurrence. The schedule shows queued/processing/completed/failed; a disconnected integration skips an occurrence with a visible failure.

sources.title: Omnara cluster v0.2.19 release
sources.finding: cluster v0.2.19 is the latest release; the cited docs are read at its tag commit.

sources.title: Omnara current clients
sources.locator: CLI installation; frontend workspace packages; README execution machines; tools/omnarad-release/main.go
sources.finding: The current distribution exposes a Node.js CLI, browser dashboard and SDK. The daemon has complete macOS/Linux build targets, and the README documents those hosts. The scoped frontend workspace ships no native iOS/Android app. Browser agent navigation adapts to mobile through AgentSidebar isMobile logic.

sources.title: Omnara agent execution kernel
sources.finding: Omnara owns the model/tool execution loop and resolves model API endpoints. Bounded inspection of the kernel and provider configuration found no integration of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Pi, Grok, Aider or Antigravity coding-harness sessions. Model endpoints use supplied API credentials; no agent-subscription login adapter is implemented.

sources.title: Omnara persisted agent records
sources.locator: Agent record queries; internal/httpapi routes; frontend/apps/web/src/routes
sources.finding: The scoped persisted work records and UI/API routes manage agent conversations, profiles, events, integrations and schedules. Inspection of the database query models, HTTP routes and web pages found no independent product-owned issue/backlog CRUD and work-item state model.

sources.title: Omnara artifact interface
sources.locator: Artifact card and agent conversation components
sources.finding: The scoped agent UI renders event timelines and downloadable artifact cards. Inspection of the conversation/artifact components found no proposed-code-change or code-diff review interface; GitHub tools and external pull requests are separate.

sources.title: Omnara pricing
sources.finding: Cloud has a $0 platform fee and no seat fees; optional managed models and machine runtime/retention are consumption-billed, with a 5% service fee on purchased managed-resource credits. Enterprise deployment, integrations, SSO setup and support require contact; no public monthly Enterprise price or subscription/one-time software licence plan is listed.
